summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` (a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle with obfuscator.io-style shuffled string arrays, hex-named identifiers, and a rotator function). The obfuscated payload is unrelated to the package's declared ESLint plugin purpose (the ordinary-looking `lib/index.js` folder-lint rule) and is executed via the fetched alternate runtime so that Node-based static analysis does not observe its behavior. Package metadata claims authorship by ServiceTitan and points to `github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint`, but the install-time Bun-runtime fetch and execution of an obfuscated bundle have no relationship to that project. The result is arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at `npm install` time under a runtime the package fetches itself.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
